phases.text: PH1 — Financial Foundation Required scope: Multi-tenant architecture, legal entities/books, chart, periods, currencies/rates, journal engine, controls and core reporting. Proposed tasks: B03 B04 B05 B06 B07 B08 B09 B10 B11 B12 B43 B44 B45 Acceptance boundary: Future implementation acceptance at B45. B01/B02 are preparation, not completion. Dependency / inactive scope: PAA/claims/operational migration need not be fully implemented to accept an explicitly inactive foundation. No permission to post actual operational transactions without their policy/reconciliation gates.

PH2 — Insurance Operational Accounting Required scope: Premium receivables/collections/allocations, commissions, claims, reinsurance, tax/levy, refunds/adjustments. Proposed tasks: B13 B14 B15 B16 B17 B18 B19 B26 Acceptance boundary: Product/profile-specific policy and independent transaction reconciliation gates apply. Dependency / inactive scope: Any operational branch that needs approved measurement/FX/legal scope waits for that prerequisite. Phase labels never permit duplicate recognition.

PH3 — Financial Operations Required scope: Bank reconciliation, AP/expenses, fixed assets, budgets and financial closing. Proposed tasks: B27 B28 B29 B31 B33 Acceptance boundary: Core operational close can be scoped; full close also requires complete applicable reporting and later advanced evidence. Dependency / inactive scope: B30 payroll/benefits only where in approved scope. B33 full close follows B32. This dependency is visible rather than a promise that phase numbers alone make work ready.

PH4 — Advanced Insurance Financial Reporting Required scope: IFRS 17, scoped IFRS 9, full IAS 21 translation, statutory/reporting disclosures and regulatory reconciliation. Proposed tasks: B21 B22 B23 B24 B25 B32 Acceptance boundary: Independent actuarial/accounting/legal certification and full component reconciliation before affected activation. Dependency / inactive scope: PAA/GMM/held eligibility explicit. VFA/future participating scope remains inactive until supported and approved. Regulatory operational records start in B26.

PH5 — Platform Expansion Required scope: Additional entities/jurisdictions/profiles, intercompany/consolidation and advanced analytics. Proposed tasks: B20 B46 Acceptance boundary: Initial applicable coinsurance treatment may be taken from B20; future client-money/profile activation follows legal applicability. Dependency / inactive scope: The broad target stays in all 33 module coverage. Optional inactive profile or payroll scope must be explicitly reviewed, not silently excluded.

DEP — Release and service extraction Required scope: Actual migration/shadow/opening/cutover/aftercare and eventual independent service with own PostgreSQL/APIs/workers/controls. Proposed tasks: B34 B35 B36 B37 B38 B39 B40 B41 B42 Acceptance boundary: Cross-phase delivery gates, not a renumbering of the user's five implementation phases. Dependency / inactive scope: Separate physical extraction remains last after actual financial and operational equivalence. No source deletion or deployment permission from the backlog.
